listing.name: Mega Man 8 — mm8 (douglasjv)
listing.summary: Experimental project. Experimental psxrecomp-tweaks integration faithful baseline; no gameplay qualification borrowed from other MegaMan8 repo. These are the project’s reports; See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SLUS-00453 Mega Man 8 CHD and 512 KiB SCPH1001 BIOS. Keep your original game files separately. The recorded source review did not download or run the game.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the project’s tools/extract_chd.sh and tools/build-macos.sh instructions, then start Mega_Man_8_Recompiled with your own CUE. Portcove does not manage this download and has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

warnings: This experimental psxrecomp-tweaks integration aims to preserve the original game. Results from another Mega Man 8 repository do not establish that this version works. These are the project’s reports; Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
